children: Japanese government bond yields are lower, as fears about energy inflation moderate. Crude oil fell overnight amid easing concerns about Middle Eastern supplies. Investors are focusing on the Bank of Japan's policy meeting and Gov. Kazuo Ueda's press conference later Friday to infer the pace of future rate increases. The central bank is expected to raise its policy rate by a quarter percentage point to 1.25% on Friday. Some economists say fast-paced increases could discourage corporate capital expenditures at a time when the Iran conflict has raised uncertainty over the economic outlook. The 10-year JGB yield is 3.5 basis points lower at 2.955%. The 2-year yield is down 1 basis point at 1.850%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
